task.description: WF-02 step 02e (ORCH): operator commands for the login-directory pepper rotation tooling

result.summary: OPERATOR ACTION REFERENCE (no action is required until a rotation is planned). RELEASE FORM (a deployed release container has NO Mix; verified on QA by infra T-0154): put the one-line expression in expr.exs and feed it via STDIN, never inline: ssh <host> "docker exec -i letflow-qa-app-1 sh -c 'timeout 300 bin/letflow rpc \"$(cat)\"'" < expr.exs 2>expr.err (default exec user/workdir, run as bin/letflow exactly, timeout 300 as a hang guard, stderr kept separate: harmless ESOCK/libsctp warning at rpc start; smoke check first: docker exec letflow-qa-app-1 sh -c 'bin/letflow rpc "IO.puts(Code.ensure_loaded?(Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill))"' prints true). Each expression is ONE line that prints its own result with IO.puts; pass/fail = a SUMMARY line present (backfill: also failed=0), NOT the exit status. Output is key ids/tenant ids/counts/atoms only, never an email or secret. The exact expressions for backfill dry/real, key_status and retire_key dry/real are in docs/runbooks/login-directory-pepper-rotation.md section 0. KEY STATUS: case Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.key_status() do {:ok, rows} -> Enum.each(rows, fn {k, c} -> IO.puts("key_id=#{k} rows=#{c}") end); IO.puts("SUMMARY key_ids=#{length(rows)} rows=#{Enum.sum(Enum.map(rows, &elem(&1, 1)))}"); {:error, e} -> IO.puts("ERROR #{inspect(e)}") end RETIRE A KEY ID (irreversible deletion of that pepper's rows; refuses the current id and an absent id; replace old-key-id; dry run first): case Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.retire_key("old-key-id", dry_run: true) do {:ok, r} -> IO.puts("SUMMARY key_id=#{r.key_id} rows=#{r.rows} dry_run=#{r.dry_run}"); {:error, e} -> IO.puts("ERROR #{inspect(e)}") end then for real: case Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.retire_key("old-key-id") do {:ok, r} -> IO.puts("SUMMARY key_id=#{r.key_id} rows=#{r.rows} dry_run=#{r.dry_run}"); {:error, e} -> IO.puts("ERROR #{inspect(e)}") end BACKFILL (re-keying step): dry run case Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run(dry_run: true) do {:ok, r} -> Enum.each(r.tenants, fn t -> IO.puts("tenant #{t.tenant_id}: users_read=#{t.users_read} keys=#{t.keys} inserted=#{t.inserted}") end); Enum.each(r.failed, fn f -> IO.puts("tenant #{f.tenant_id}: FAILED reason=#{f.reason}") end); IO.puts("SUMMARY dry_run=#{r.dry_run} tenants=#{length(r.tenants)} failed=#{length(r.failed)} inserted=#{Enum.sum(Enum.map(r.tenants, & &1.inserted))} key_id=#{r.key_id}"); {:error, e} -> IO.puts("ERROR #{inspect(e)}") end then for real the same with Backfill.run(). Mix forms for dev/CI: mix letflow.login_directory.key_status, mix letflow.login_directory.retire_key --key-id OLD_ID [--dry-run], mix letflow.backfill_login_directory [--dry-run]. Full procedure: docs/runbooks/login-directory-pepper-rotation.md.
